items.rationale: The packet directly supports the evaluator counts, paired effect, resample count, and interval, but it does not identify an 18-cell study or establish that this study was frozen. Those are material design descriptors in the claim.
decisive_evidence: paired_analysis contains the stated effect, 10,000 resamples, and interval, but linked_evidence contains no 18-cell or frozen-study field

decisive_evidence: execution_boundary: The controller, conclusion generator, and gate were not rerun.

items.rationale: The path counts, paired difference, p-value, model revision, and model hash all match the claim. However, the packet identifies only the NLI proxy; it supplies no comparator model family or upstream-model binding from which the material 'cross-family' description can be checked.
decisive_evidence: path_P0.neutral_or_abstain = 5 and contradiction = 0; P1, P2, and P3 each have zero neutral_or_abstain and contradiction
model_binding gives one model_id, revision, and onnx_sha256 but no second family binding needed to verify 'cross-family'

items.rationale: The retention fields exactly match the claimed counts, and all 36 revised-to-final claim traces are unchanged with zero word, character, and numeric-token deltas. The supplied scope boundary limits the inference to no observed marginal change in this artifact sample.
decisive_evidence: retention: P1 retained 22 of 36; P2 and P3 each retained 36 of 36
revised_to_final: claim_trace_count = 36; change_types.unchanged = 36; word_delta = 0; character_delta = 0; numeric_token_delta = 0
scope_boundary: No observed marginal change in this artifact sample; not a general claim that rechecking is useless.

items.rationale: The packet supports no measured difference between P2 and P3 and states the retrospective, uncalibrated, non-ground-truth limits. But it gives neither a P0 baseline nor definitions mapping P1 and P2 to the first verification and delivery decision, so the claimed localization of improvement is not directly established.
decisive_evidence: observations: P1, P2, and P3 each have zero NLI non-entailment; P2 and P3 are identical on all measured outcomes
explicit_limits include retrospective post-hoc design, no human calibration, and lexical proxies are not semantic-preservation ground truth

items.rationale: The bounded review supports only the broader absence of a controlled claim-level evidence-audit ablation in 12 abstract- or notes-level records. It does not directly document the same-backbone, same-task, same-budget criteria, the immediately-before-delivery placement, or that the reviewed set was frozen.
decisive_evidence: review_scope: Bounded abstract/notes-based synthesis of 12 verified 2024-2026 records
gap_statement describes a controlled ablation of a claim-level evidence audit in an end-to-end research agent
linked_evidence contains no fields for same backbone, same task, same budget, immediate pre-delivery placement, or frozen-set status
